restriction.android:title: Enable Full Lockdown
restriction.android:description: When true, forces PAC proxy, blocks all non-whitelisted sites, disables navigation UI, and applies maximum restrictions. Can also be triggered by remote FCM command.

restriction.android:title: PAC File URL
restriction.android:description: URL of the Proxy Auto-Config (PAC) file. Default is the Cloudflare Gateway PAC for this deployment.

restriction.android:title: Inline PAC Content (overrides URL)
restriction.android:description: Full PAC JavaScript content. If set, used instead of pac_url. Leave empty to use the bundled Cloudflare Gateway PAC.

restriction.android:title: Force System Proxy via Device Policy
restriction.android:description: If true and app is Device/Profile Owner, sets global HTTP proxy / PAC via DevicePolicyManager.

restriction.android:title: Allowed Domains (Whitelist)
restriction.android:description: Comma-separated domains that are always allowed even in lockdown (e.g. company.com,google.com)

restriction.android:title: Blocked Categories
restriction.android:description: Comma-separated categories to block (adult,social,gambling,streaming,ads). Used with local category lists.

restriction.android:title: Allowed Hours Start (HH:mm)
restriction.android:description: Start of allowed browsing window (24h). Empty = no time restriction.

restriction.android:title: Organization / Tenant ID
restriction.android:description: Firebase / enterprise tenant identifier for multi-tenant policy sync.

restriction.android:title: MDM Enrollment Token
restriction.android:description: Token used to authenticate remote lockdown commands from the management console.
